title: Producing GST-Cbx7 Fusion Proteins from Escherichia coli
author: Thao Ngoc Huynh
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare LB medium
steps.instruction: Autoclave 1 L of LB medium containing 10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, and 5 g NaCl; adjust pH to 7.2.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer
steps.instruction: Make wash buffer by mixing 1× PBS with 1 % (v/v) Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 1× PBS with 0.1 mM PMSF and 0.1 mM protease inhibitor cocktail.

steps.title: Prepare elution buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve reduced glutathione to 20 mM in PBS, adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH.

steps.title: Transform BL21 cells
steps.instruction: Introduce pGEX‑6P‑1‑GST plasmid into BL21 cells and recover transformed cells.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plasmid with competent BL21 cells on ice for 10 min.
Heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s.
Return to ice for 2 min.
Add LB medium and incubate 1 h at 37 °C while shaking at 250–300 rpm.
Plate cells on agar containing ampicillin and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Grow starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony into 100 mL LB with 100 µg/mL ampicillin; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 250–300 rpm.

steps.title: Scale‑up expression culture
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL overnight culture to 950 mL warm fresh LB with 100 µg/mL ampicillin; grow at 37 °C, 250–300 rpm until OD₆₀₀ = 0.5–0.7.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to a final concentration of 1.0 mM (stock 100 mM prepared by dissolving powder in MilliQ water and filtering); incubate 5 h at 37 °C, 250–300 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation and remove supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture at 4,000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Decant supernatant, leaving ~15–50 mL in the bottle.
Resuspend the pellet, transfer to a 50 mL conical tube, and centrifuge again at 4,000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Decant the second supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 25 mL lysis buffer and sonicate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Set sonicator to 15 s on / 45 s off cycles at 45 % amplitude.
Apply cycles for a total on‑time of 6 min.

steps.title: Solubilize protein
steps.instruction: Add Triton X‑100 to a final concentration of 1 % and mix gently for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sonicated suspension at 10,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash Glutathione Sepharose beads
steps.instruction: Pre‑wash 0.75 mL of beads with cold PBS.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 × 10 mL cold PBS to the beads, centrifuge at 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C each wash.

steps.title: Bind GST‑fusion protein
steps.instruction: Incubate clarified supernatant with pre‑washed beads to capture GST‑Cbx7.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to the beads in a conical tube.
Rotate at 4 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Collect beads
steps.instruction: Separate beads from unbound material.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash bound beads
steps.instruction: Remove nonspecifically bound proteins.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads with 4 × 10 mL wash buffer.

steps.title: Column wash
steps.instruction: Transfer beads to a Bio‑Rad Econo‑Column and perform final washes.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 2 × 10 mL cold PBS.

steps.title: Elute GST‑fusion protein
steps.instruction: Recover protein from beads using reduced glutathione.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL elution buffer to the beads, incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Collect eluate.
Repeat the incubation two more times for a total of three 10‑min elutions.

steps.title: Dialyze protein
steps.instruction: Exchange eluates into PBS by dialysis, performing three successive buffer changes.

steps.title: Assess purity by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run an SDS‑PAGE gel and stain with Coomassie Blue to evaluate the purity and identity of the GST‑Cbx7 variants.
